spec.rawSQL:
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100 - 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sc_status NOT BETWEEN 200 AND 299 OR TRY_CAST(time_taken AS DOUBLE) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(time_taken AS DOUBLE) > 0.2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2), 100) AS "1-User"
FROM apdev.cloudfront_standard_logs
WHERE cs_uri_stem = '/v1/user'
AND $__timeFilter(TRY_CAST(CONCAT(CAST("date" AS VARCHAR), ' ', CAST("time" AS VARCHAR)) AS TIMESTAMP));

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100 - 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sc_status NOT BETWEEN 200 AND 299 OR TRY_CAST(time_taken AS DOUBLE) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(time_taken AS DOUBLE) > 0.2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2), 100) AS "2-Product"
FROM apdev.cloudfront_standard_logs
WHERE cs_uri_stem = '/v1/product'
AND $__timeFilter(TRY_CAST(CONCAT(CAST("date" AS VARCHAR), ' ', CAST("time" AS VARCHAR)) AS TIMESTAMP));

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100 - 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sc_status NOT BETWEEN 200 AND 299 OR TRY_CAST(time_taken AS DOUBLE) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(time_taken AS DOUBLE) > 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2), 100) AS "3-Stress"
FROM apdev.cloudfront_standard_logs
WHERE cs_uri_stem = '/v1/stress'
AND $__timeFilter(TRY_CAST(CONCAT(CAST("date" AS VARCHAR), ' ', CAST("time" AS VARCHAR)) AS TIMESTAMP));

spec.expr:
100 * sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="apdev", pod=~"apdev-user-.*", container!="", container!="POD", image!=""})

sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="apdev", pod=~"apdev-user-.*", resource="memory", unit="byte"})

100 * sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="apdev", pod=~"apdev-product-.*", container!="", container!="POD", image!=""})
/
sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="apdev", pod=~"apdev-product-.*", resource="memory", unit="byte"})

100 * sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="apdev", pod=~"apdev-stress-.*", container!="", container!="POD", image!=""})
/
sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="apdev", pod=~"apdev-stress-.*", resource="memory", unit="byte"})
